\chapter{Hand and Money: No New Signs}
\label{ch:mw-travel-five}
\hlchaptermodality{15}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can add hand and money to the three-place map in listening, speaking, reading, and writing without learning another sign.}

Hand and money arrive by ear, reuse the complete script inventory, and join the three places in a non-compensatory four-skill payoff.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[hāth]{Hear \emph{hāth} — hand}

\label{lesson:MW-C10-hear-haath}



\begin{quote}
Recall the three-place and water four-skill payoffs, then say home.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{hāth} — \textbf{hand}
\end{quote}

The source uses this word in right-hand and left-hand direction cues. Say the one long beat. Writing waits even though every sign is familiar.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-5-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 5}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[hāth]{\mw{हाथ} — hand on the page}

\label{lesson:MW-C10-haath}



\begin{quote}
Say hand and my, write \textbf{\mw{ह}}, \textbf{\mw{ा}}, \textbf{\mw{थ}}, \textbf{\mw{घर}}, and \textbf{\mw{पति}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mw{हा}} + \textbf{\mw{थ}} $\to$ \textbf{\mw{हाथ}} — \emph{hāth} — hand
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Look, cover, wait five seconds, and write the word.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-5-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 5}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[paisā]{Hear \emph{paisā} — money}

\label{lesson:MW-C10-hear-paisa}



\begin{quote}
Say hand and market, write virama \textbf{\mw{्}}, then recall the ten-label four-skill checkpoint.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{paisā} — \textbf{money}
\end{quote}

The source uses this word when asking travel cost. Hear the opening \emph{pai} and say the whole word. Writing waits until the next step.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-5-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 5}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[paisā]{\mw{पैसा} — money on the page}

\label{lesson:MW-C10-paisa}



\begin{quote}
Say money, hand, and wife. Write \textbf{\mw{प}}, \textbf{\mw{ै}}, \textbf{\mw{स}}, \textbf{\mw{ा}}, \textbf{\mw{ो}}, then \textbf{\mw{हाथ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mw{पै}} + \textbf{\mw{सा}} $\to$ \textbf{\mw{पैसा}} — \emph{paisā} — money
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Look, cover, wait five seconds, and write the word. Check \textbf{\mw{ै}} before \textbf{\mw{ा}}.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-5-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 5}.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[Practice]{Payoff — five travel words in four skills}

\label{lesson:MW-C10-travel-five}



\begin{quote}
Recall the three-place checkpoint, then say name and child before adding hand and money.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}

Pass each skill separately.
